# pve_notification_targets (Data Source)

All usable notification targets (endpoints, matchers, built-ins).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_notification_targets" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `endpoint_types` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /cluster/notifications/endpoints (the API schema does not describe its shape).
- `id` (String) Identifier: .
- `index` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /cluster/notifications (the API schema does not describe its shape).
- `targets` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/notifications/targets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

<a id="nestedatt--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Comment
- `disable` (Boolean) Show if this target is disabled
- `name` (String) Name of the target.
- `origin` (String) Show if this entry was created by a user or was built-in
- `type` (String) Type of the target.
